column1: # openXC7-vs-Vivado benchmark — design table (fields separated by '|')
# name | dir (relative to designs/) | top module | part | xdc | verilog sources (relative to dir) | data-file globs copied into the run dir
# Configurations mirror the openXC7 demo-projects CI (smoke.yml at the frozen
# main revision). picosoc: BOARD=qmtech -> xc7k325tffg676-1, top module `top`
# (in qmtech.v), XDC picosoc-qmtech.xdc. The previous kx2 config
# (xc7k160tffg676-2, kx2.v) fails Vivado DRC PLIO-9 — the clock is LOCed to an
# N-type CCIO — so it cannot produce a Vivado baseline (kept in
# designs.tsv.bak-kx2). NOTE: picosoc-qmtech.xdc carries NO active
# create_clock (line 4 is commented out; the clock lives in qmtech.sdc, which
# this non-project XDC flow does not read) -> the picosoc row is unconstrained
# and its wns/tns/timing_met columns are not meaningful (met=na, like blinky).
# exactly as their Makefiles do (VexRiscv.v DIFFERS between the two revisions).
